Questions owners ask

What if you disappear?

You own the code and the data. It runs on standard tools, it's backed up, and any engineer can take it over.

How much of my time does it take?

A few conversations at the start, so we understand how you work. After that, you ask for changes when you notice them, in a sentence.

How soon is there a first version?

Usually within days of those first conversations. Your team uses it alongside the old system until it has earned its place.

Does it work with what we already use?

Yes. It connects to the tools you keep, such as QuickBooks, and brings in what lives in your spreadsheets today.

Where does our data live?

In your own database, on standard cloud hosting, backed up every night. It's yours.

Who checks the AI's work?

Every change is written with its tests first and goes live only after the whole test suite passes and the change has been reviewed. Anything that touches money or another company's system waits for Elliot.

How it starts

  1. A first conversation about how your business works today.
  2. A first version your team can use, usually within days.
  3. You switch off the old system when you're ready. That's when the setup fee is due.
